shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin soared past $79,000 driven by strong institutional ETF inflows.
Macroeconomic tailwinds like a weaker USD and Fed rate cut hopes fueled the crypto rally.
Trump's pro-crypto remarks and push for the Clarity Act boosted market optimism.
A flash crash liquidated $1.7 billion in leveraged long positions across crypto markets.
Altcoins like Zcash and TRUMP memecoin saw significant surges; Solana improved speed.
